verdict.rationale: Secureframe publishes a complete OpenAPI 3.0.0 definition ('title: Secureframe API'), embedded in the source of its rendered API reference page at api.secureframe.com/docs. That reference has request/response schemas and a documented versioning policy, so a machine-readable spec does exist. However, no separate raw-spec download URL is documented, so users must pull the spec out of a ~490KB HTML page rather than download it directly. Missing for 10: a documented, dedicated openapi.json/yaml download endpoint, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the embedded spec can be extracted and used.
